title: Deep learning for prediction of hepatocellular carcinoma recurrence after resection or liver transplantation: a discovery and validation study.
summary: The study trained on 552 resection patients and tested on a 144-patient transplant cohort and 302 TCGA cases; recurrence-free-survival associations were reported. The cohorts are retrospective, the training set used selected outcome groups, and prospective clinical utility was not tested. The first located result-bearing version was arXiv v1 (2021-05-31); the journal version appeared online 2022-03-29. The date is the first located result-bearing preprint; the later peer-reviewed journal version is linked separately.
ai_technology: A U-Net segmentation heat map was combined with color-normalized histology tiles for a MobileNetV2 classifier estimating hepatocellular-carcinoma recurrence risk.
organization: Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, Affiliated Hangzhou First People’s Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine; Syracuse University
